svg.text: System diagram: region-locked image editing prototype
One static web page (GitHub Pages). Everything runs in the browser: no server, no API key, no AI model is called.
SYSTEM SIDE: deterministic code (app.js) that the user can rely on
MODEL SIDE: rules standing in for AI models
stands in for a language model · readInstruction()
stands in for a segmentation model · objectMap()
pixel colour → rug, cat, vase, roses …;
advice: words name the painted objects → A (whole) or B (painted part)
otherwise → C (changes exactly what is painted)
changing the mode rebuilds the edit card
rows: You asked · Mode · Read from your words · Will change · Will be kept
red box blocks Confirm when the run would change nothing
yellow box warns, e.g. in A the brush touches more than one object
Each rule on this side could be swapped for a real
model without changing the system side.
The model's output goes only to Lock enforcement:
it never reaches the user without passing the lock.
stands in for an image-editing model · simulateModel()
A: every object the brush touches, whole
B: named objects, only where painted
C: every painted pixel, whatever it is
all modes: unwanted extra changes too
(cat turns grey, vase and roses vanish)
reads the original image, mask and confirmed plan
part of named objects; C: painted
make_sample.py draws samples/room.png → embed_samples.py writes static/samples.js
simulated: a rule stands in for a model
Function names refer to static/app.js and static/rules.js in github.com/Lottie97-a11y/iisproject (version of 22 Nov).
